verdict.rationale: Codex's docs say you can start it in a repository to explore unfamiliar code, and that it inspects files and runs local tools on its own, so you don't hand-pick context files. Subagents can split up a larger investigation and report findings back to the main session. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of whole-codebase mapping or architecture-summary output, any stated repo-indexing or context-scaling mechanism for large codebases, and independent hands-on corroboration of codebase-explanation quality.
